unit: one HERSHEY'S Milk Chocolate Candy Bar, 1.55 oz / 43 g

buckets.label: Sugar

ingredient_story.origin: Sugar is modeled as an upstream sweetener input. Hershey sugar sourcing evidence and ASR evidence support company-level sugar sourcing context, while exact SKU-level allocation remains unconfirmed.
ingredient_story.processing: Farm cane/beet sugar stream → milling/refining → refined sugar input → Hershey manufacturing.
limitations: Supplier relationship is company-level only unless stated otherwise.
Exact 1.55 oz SKU-level allocation is not publicly confirmed.
Use safe wording only; do not claim exact supplier-to-bar allocation.

buckets.cost_logic: Estimated sugar grams are anchored to the 43 g bar and expected sugar-heavy chocolate formulation. Price is a refined-sugar benchmark proxy, not Hershey invoice cost.
buckets.notes: Calculated from modeled grams per 43 g bar and benchmark price per lb. Not Hershey actual cost.

buckets.label: Chocolate / Cocoa

ingredient_story.origin: Cocoa/chocolate is modeled as a major upstream cocoa stream. Barry Callebaut evidence supports company-level cocoa/chocolate relationship context, while exact SKU-level allocation remains unconfirmed.
ingredient_story.processing: Cocoa origin/processing → cocoa liquor/chocolate inputs → Hershey manufacturing.
limitations: Supplier relationship is company-level only unless stated otherwise.
Exact 1.55 oz SKU-level allocation is not publicly confirmed.
Use safe wording only; do not claim exact supplier-to-bar allocation.

buckets.cost_logic: Cocoa/chocolate mass allocation is estimated because Hershey does not disclose the exact bill of materials. Benchmark price represents cocoa/chocolate ingredient proxy, not actual contract price.
buckets.notes: Calculated from modeled grams per 43 g bar and benchmark price per lb. Not Hershey actual cost.

buckets.label: Cocoa Butter

ingredient_story.origin: Cocoa butter is modeled as part of the cocoa ingredient stream. Public evidence supports company-level cocoa/chocolate context, not exact SKU-level cocoa butter supplier allocation.
ingredient_story.processing: Cocoa bean processing → cocoa liquor pressing/separation → cocoa butter input → chocolate manufacturing.
limitations: Supplier relationship is company-level only unless stated otherwise.
Exact 1.55 oz SKU-level allocation is not publicly confirmed.
Use safe wording only; do not claim exact supplier-to-bar allocation.

buckets.cost_logic: Cocoa butter is modeled separately from cocoa/chocolate because it is a distinct ingredient stream. Weight and price are benchmark assumptions.
buckets.notes: Calculated from modeled grams per 43 g bar and benchmark price per lb. Not Hershey actual cost.

buckets.label: Milk / Dairy Solids

ingredient_story.origin: Milk is modeled as a dairy input. Hershey/Land O'Lakes evidence supports company-level dairy relationship context, while exact SKU-level dairy allocation remains unconfirmed.
ingredient_story.processing: Dairy farms → cooperative/processor → milk stream → Hershey manufacturing.
limitations: Supplier relationship is company-level only.
Exact 1.55 oz SKU-level dairy allocation is not publicly confirmed.
Use safe wording only; do not claim exact supplier-to-bar allocation.

buckets.cost_logic: Milk is modeled as a dairy solids input rather than liquid milk weight. Price is a dairy product benchmark proxy.
buckets.notes: Calculated from modeled grams per 43 g bar and benchmark price per lb. Not Hershey actual cost.

buckets.label: Skim Milk / Nonfat Solids

ingredient_story.origin: Skim milk is modeled as part of the dairy solids stream. Supplier is treated as company-level dairy context, not SKU-level confirmation.
ingredient_story.processing: Milk separation → skim/nonfat solids stream → chocolate ingredient input.
limitations: Supplier relationship is company-level only.
Exact 1.55 oz SKU-level dairy allocation is not publicly confirmed.
Use safe wording only; do not claim exact supplier-to-bar allocation.

buckets.cost_logic: Skim milk is proxied with nonfat dry milk / dairy solids pricing. Exact ingredient form and quantity are not publicly disclosed.
buckets.notes: Calculated from modeled grams per 43 g bar and benchmark price per lb. Not Hershey actual cost.

buckets.label: Milk Fat / Butterfat

ingredient_story.origin: Milk fat is modeled as part of the dairy fat stream. Supplier evidence supports company-level dairy context, not exact SKU-level allocation.
ingredient_story.processing: Milk separation → cream/butterfat stream → milk fat input → chocolate manufacturing.
limitations: Supplier relationship is company-level only.
Exact 1.55 oz SKU-level dairy allocation is not publicly confirmed.
Use safe wording only; do not claim exact supplier-to-bar allocation.

buckets.cost_logic: Milk fat is proxied using butterfat/butter-related dairy benchmarks. Exact milk fat quantity is modeled, not disclosed.
buckets.notes: Calculated from modeled grams per 43 g bar and benchmark price per lb. Not Hershey actual cost.

buckets.label: Packaging / Wrapper / Secondary Packaging
buckets.cost_logic: Packaging includes primary wrapper plus allocated paperboard/case packaging. Exact wrapper supplier and exact SKU packaging cost are not public.
buckets.notes: Allocation estimate. Not Hershey actual SKU-level cost.

buckets.label: Manufacturing Conversion
buckets.cost_logic: Manufacturing conversion includes labor, utilities, overhead, maintenance, depreciation, and plant operations allocation. This is a modeled public-information allocation, not Hershey internal SKU accounting.
buckets.notes: Allocation estimate. Not Hershey actual SKU-level cost.

buckets.label: Storage / Warehousing
buckets.cost_logic: Storage and warehousing are allocated using public logistics/warehousing benchmark context. Exact SKU storage cost is not public.
buckets.notes: Allocation estimate. Not Hershey actual SKU-level cost.

buckets.label: Outbound Freight / Trucking
buckets.cost_logic: Freight is allocated using trucking/diesel/logistics benchmark context. Exact route cost for the 1.55 oz SKU is not public.
buckets.notes: Allocation estimate. Not Hershey actual SKU-level cost.

buckets.label: Observed Retail Shelf Price
buckets.cost_logic: Retail price is calculated from manually verified retailer pages for the exact HERSHEY'S 1.55 oz / 43 g single bar.
buckets.notes: Retail prices are visually verified from collected retailer evidence. Prices may vary by store, date, and promotion.

buckets.label: Residual Channel / Commercial Pool

calculation_inputs.definition: Residual channel/commercial pool = observed retail shelf price minus estimated physical supply-chain cost. It is not profit. It can include retailer margin, distributor margin, trade promotions, taxes/fees where applicable, corporate SG&A allocation, brand economics, and estimation error.
calculation_inputs.safe_display_wording: The residual is the gap between observed shelf price and estimated physical cost. It should not be interpreted as Hershey profit or retailer profit.
